description: Election Commission - Mrs. Y. W. A. D. Janaki of the Vhana Preadeshiya Sabha has Vacated her office of that Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local authority (Uhana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls under electoral processes as it directly relates to the composition of an elected local government body under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically addressing the circumstances under which an elected office becomes vacant.
